recoveryRules: Keep every original games/trace/lock file untouched, including the two interrupted attempts.

The first interrupted attempts for logical shards 4/5 contain no committed seed and no failure rows. Run the exact original config and frozen standalone bundle into separately named recovery directories.

Before recovered data is eligible for analysis, every completed original trace raw line must match the same game identity in its recovered shard byte-for-byte; any mismatch stops acceptance, never choose a favorable attempt.
Preserve all frozen seeds, seats, lineups, openings, policies, three comparisons and seed-cluster statistics. No new scientific tuning or outcome-based scheduling.
Keep at most two shards live; require fresh >=2GiB free physical memory before launching a second concurrent shard. Queue shard 6 until a slot is available.
Every worker or policy error stops that shard and prevents queued launches. Do not retry scientific failures.
A detached hidden coordinator records each child PID and actual exit code. Verify operating-system liveness, not only a status file.

After all six declared grids complete, verify original hashes, complete source and runtime, replay every stored action and reconcile all T/E result and full trace controls against both existing UI/external followups.
For historical shard 2/3, distinguish old missing process exit evidence from a later frozen CLI no-op validation and full stored-action replay. Do not claim historical terminal0.
